senses.zh_definition: 见于乌克兰人名的姓氏 Savych；在马来语文本中用作专有名词，通常保留所采用的拉丁字母拼写。
senses.en_definition: A surname attested in Ukrainian names, retained as a proper name in Malay text.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang ditemukan dalam nama orang Ukraine dan digunakan sebagai nama khas dalam teks bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 此处为专有名词，未核实为 DBP 收录的马来语普通词，故不标记 official。输入未指明具体人物，不能据此补写其身份、性别或个人背景。排名仅来自输入数据集；以下为示例性姓名搭配和虚构对话，不宣称语料高频。

etymology.historical_story: Savych appears in Ukrainian historical naming. The Encyclopedia of Ukraine records a Cossack officer family established by Sava Prokopovych and describes later members active in administration and scholarship. This supplies historical context for the surname, rather than a Malay word origin. It does not show that every modern bearer belongs to that particular family. [Encyclopedia of Ukraine](https://www.encyclopediaofukraine.com/display.asp?linkpath=pages%5CS%5CA%5CSavych.htm).
